claims: Ryan Coogler's Sinners (2025) secured 16 Oscar nominations at the 98th Academy Awards (2026).
16 Oscar nominations is the most for any single film in Academy history.
Sinners is a Southern Gothic vampire thriller.
Sinners broke the previous record of 14 Oscar nominations.
All About Eve (1950) had 14 Oscar nominations.
Titanic (1997) had 14 Oscar nominations.
La La Land (2016) had 14 Oscar nominations.
Sinners won four awards at the 2026 Oscars.
Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor in a Leading Role for Sinners at the 2026 Oscars.
Ryan Coogler won Best Original Screenplay for Sinners at the 2026 Oscars.
Autumn Durald Arkapaw won Best Cinematography for Sinners at the 2026 Oscars.
Autumn Durald Arkapaw is the first woman to win the Best Cinematography Oscar.
Ludwig Göransson won Best Original Score for Sinners at the 2026 Oscars.
Sinners was nominated for Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards.
Ryan Coogler was nominated for Director for Sinners at the 98th Academy Awards.
Michael B. Jordan was nominated for Actor for Sinners at the 98th Academy Awards.
Lindo was nominated for a supporting role for Sinners at the 98th Academy Awards.
Mosaku was nominated for a supporting role for Sinners at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sinners was nominated for cinematography at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sinners was nominated for screenplay at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sinners was nominated for technical categories at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sinners grossed over $156 million.
Some reports indicate Sinners grossed up to $368 million worldwide.
